items: [fix] The MCP reconnect rule reached only new projects: it was plain text in CLAUDE.md, and the update changes an existing CLAUDE.md only inside the kit blocks. It is now the `mcp-reconnect` block, so `update-my-profile` + a session start writes it into every project (a copy added by hand is replaced, never doubled).
release.title: v1.124.55 — The MCP rule reaches every project's CLAUDE.md
